text:
I didn’t start in gaming—my first role was in finance, building tools for data analysis. But when I discovered how code could shape immersive experiences, I knew I wanted to pivot. Now, as a junior frontend engineer at NexGen Games, I’m translating player feedback into interactive features that bring worlds to life. My days involve balancing technical precision with creative vision, whether crafting dynamic UI components for real-time multiplayer games or optimizing layouts for cross-platform consistency.  

Right now, I’m diving deep into refining the player hub for *Rift: Echoes*, ensuring seamless navigation across mobile and desktop. I’m also collaborating with artists to prototype UI elements that feel both functional and visually aligned with the game’s aesthetic.  

HTML/CSS remains my foundation for structuring responsive, accessible interfaces, while JavaScript and React let me build interactive elements that adapt to user behavior. I’m always looking to refine my approach—whether through code reviews or experimenting with new libraries.  

Let’s connect if you’re shaping the future of gaming or curious about how code bridges art and play. I’d love to swap insights or brainstorm ways to make digital experiences more intuitive and engaging.
